failures.reason: Fixture assumed Edit remained exactly Undo/Copy. macOS dynamically adds Writing Tools, AutoFill, dictation and Emoji entries.

Diagnostic confirmed File only retained its sentinel while Edit held original Undo/Copy plus OS-added entries. Fixture now requires original identities and no target owned by any retired menu controller; it leaves OS items intact.

focused_transition_recheck.reason: After final toolbar visibility-before-attachment/zero-implicit-animation adjustment, only the affected menu/hide/show/replacement workflow was repeated. Prior eight unaffected runs were not repeated.
